name: custom/guide-references
title: Guide References
description: Auto-lists every Citation belonging to the site's one Guide, ordered by Citation Number, each with a stable anchor a chapter's inline "Cite" link can jump straight to. No picker/attributes — the site has exactly one Guide, so this always lists that one automatically. Place on a Page of your choosing (e.g. /learning/guide/references/ — a Page nested directly under /learning/guide/ collides with the Chapter permalink pattern and 404s unless a matching rewrite carve-out exists; see bitesmart_guide_references_rewrite_carveout() in guide-chapter-cpt.php).
